name: clipped 'opposing' + truncated move both recover ('pposing Sneasler used Prote')
notes: Battle 9's two truncation classes combined, on a read whose parts ARE recoverable: a fade-in clipped the side marker to 'pposing' (any ≥5-char suffix of 'opposing' now marks the opponent — the m12-G residue rule extended to the word itself) and clipped the move to 'Prote' (unique ≥5-char prefix of exactly one vocab move → Protect; battle 9's real 'Prote' polluted Kingambit's revealedMoves as a separate move).

tokens.text: BossSoffy sent out Aerodactyl and Sneasler!
